mentions.description: An AI platform that builds, runs, and grows a business from a plain description of it. It handles the business's marketing, including AI-generated UGC videos across social media, plus sales follow-up and closing sales. Users can manage the business from WhatsApp, receive weekly reports on their phone, and approve or edit anything before it goes online.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://wpmaven.ai
Describe your business and WPMaven.ai creates it, runs it and grows it for you.
It does all your marketing, including UGC videos on all social media, sales follow-up and closes sales for you.
